spec: VSL Email/Phone Gate — Skill-44 FORM object contract
status: REAL GHL object contract — NOT a stub. Skill 44 builds a live form, live custom fields, and a live Form-Submitted -> Add-Contact-Tag workflow; every creation is receipted (status:201, re-GET 200).

form.name: ZHC <SLUG> VSL Gate
form.name_note: UPPERCASE 'ZHC ' prefix is the fleet container-NAME convention (ensure_zhc_prefix). <SLUG> is replaced at build time (lowercase, hyphens).

embed_target.note: The VSL page is a Skill-6 website/funnel page; the gate form embeds in a gate overlay div. Target resolved at build time by Skill 6 (ghl_form_builder embed_target).

design.privacy_line: We respect your privacy. No spam, ever. Unsubscribe anytime.
design.brand_note: The HTML writer applies a CSS polish wrapper (Skill 6 permits optional CSS wrapper for visual polish) so the embedded form matches the Kie/Agnes VSL design — brand colors, field order, button copy, privacy line.

idempotency.rule: GET existing custom fields + tags on the location; REUSE any matching zhc_ key/name; only CREATE the remainder. Never duplicate.

workflow.name: ZHC <SLUG> VSL Gate Engaged

filter.note: Filter binds to the gate form's live id AFTER creation — built by Skill 44 only once the form exists.

steps.name: Tag: zhc_vsl_engaged
steps.note: Tag attachment is NOT native to GHL forms — the Form-Submitted -> Add Contact Tag workflow is what writes the tag.

steps.name: Route to Sales/Checkout funnel (optional)
steps.note: Optional second action routing the contact to the sales/checkout funnel or an email/SMS sequence (Skill 44 conversation templates). Skipped if the target workflow/campaign is not yet built — honest receipt.

workflow.qc: Skill 44 PLAN-MODE + QC gate (WF-1..21, rubric >= 8.5) applies. Workflows are created as DRAFT, never auto-published.
workflow.token_note: Workflow writes require GOHIGHLEVEL_FIREBASE_REFRESH_TOKEN. If dead -> 06-ghl-install-pages/tools/ghl_auth.py Tier-2 gated self-heal. If unhealable, the gate workflow is NOT built — the gate form still writes the CRM contact on submit, but tag attachment is skipped with an honest receipt.

embed_contract.sri_note: Skill 6 hard rule: the GHL form embed snippet is spliced VERBATIM into the page blob with NO SRI attributes (DESIGN-OPUS §6.2; ghl_form_builder.py 'embed VERBATIM, NO SRI attrs'). The embed token is GHL-native and page-specific; SRI is deliberately NOT applied.
embed_contract.verify: render_check 200 + snippet tag present in RENDERED DOM (ghl_verify.render_check)

write_to_crm.on_submit: GHL creates/updates the contact (email matched; first name + phone populated) -> workflow adds zhc_vsl_engaged tag -> optional follow-up (email/SMS via Skill 44 conversation templates). Standard SKILL44_WIDGET submit path, no custom code.
